description:
How can I have peace with God? What is sanctification? What is the gospel?

SDA pastor Dwayne Lemon, from PTH Ministries (@DwayneLemonPTHMinistries), gave a message titled "What is the Gospel" wherein he demonstrates how the SDA Church's extra-biblical worldview—the Great Controversy Theme—distorts all of scripture, including the ever so foundational subject of the gospel. We will look at positional vs. experiential sanctification, the nature of man, and glorification as well as how the SDA system of theology distorts all of this.
